name: oficina
description: Creates complete AI agents for any domain: /oficina:create-agent (alias /oficina:crear-agente) interviews you, researches the domain in depth and generates a universal agent folder (identity + managed memory + skills, works in Claude Code and Codex) under the La Oficina Protocol. Also installs ready-made private agents from a download code with /oficina:install-agent (alias /oficina:instalar-agente). Includes /oficina:recursive-research. Works in the user's language.
